sorted_lift_semantic_audit.verdict: Mathematically faithful; all component proofs including the exact formula wrapper are producer-complete and frozen
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.index_scope: I is any linearly ordered type, with no finiteness, countability or enumeration assumption. Finite subsets of cardinality n correspond to the strictly increasing n-tuples in the source.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.basis: Mathlib UnconditionalSchauderBasis is GeneralSchauderBasis with the unconditional summation filter: actual continuous linear coordinates, biorthogonality, and HasSum of every coordinate expansion. It is neither a Hamel-only basis nor a proxy assuming the desired lift.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.orthogonality: hb states precisely the weighted coordinate estimate ‖coord_i(x)‖·‖b_i‖≤‖x‖ used by the source. The paper’s orthogonal-norm hypothesis implies it; using this weaker sufficient hypothesis strengthens rather than weakens the result.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.scalar_and_space_assumptions: K is a nontrivially normed ultrametric field. E and E′ are normed K-spaces, not assumed complete. F is normed, complete and ultrametric. No spherical completeness assumption occurs.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.degree_and_characteristic: n is arbitrary Nat with no positivity or factorial assumption. Degree zero is included; the empty sorted set contributes the empty determinant. Characteristic two is included because the codomain is Mathlib ContinuousAlternatingMap with equality-of-two-inputs vanishing, not mere signed antisymmetry.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.operator: P has the actual continuous n-multilinear type on E→L[K]E′ with values in bounded linear operators from alternating E′-maps to alternating E-maps. Its norm is the standard ContinuousMultilinearMap operator norm and is proved ≤1.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.formula: The HasSum summand is det(coord_(s_i)(x_j)) • m(fun i=>f_i(b_(s_i))), with precisely the row/column ordering in the source. The wrapper also gives equality with tsum and P(f,…,f)=Q(f).
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.convergence: Actual cofinite decay and Summable are proved in SortedBasisSummability; SortedBasisExpansion proves the exact value by finite exterior-basis expansion, cofinal projected sums and continuity. Convergence is not an extra hypothesis.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.arbitrary_finite_form_index: SortedBasisAnalytic additionally supplies hasBoundedLift/analyticity for arbitrary finite ι by genuine reindexing, while the explicit sorted formula is naturally in Fin n.
sorted_lift_semantic_audit.proof_route: Construct the sorted retraction on the finite coordinate span, extend it densely with its norm bound, then identify it with the convergent determinant family. This is equivalent to the source’s direct sum construction.
